status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE ANY CANDIDATE OUTCOME WAS COMPUTED
createdBy: Stage VII, before running the weight sweep

control.reproductionGate: CONTROL must reproduce from production compute_overall_rip_v10 inputs with 0 mismatches; otherwise COLLECTOR_STAGE7_BLOCKED_CONTROL_REPRODUCTION_FAILURE

baselines.note: the three-pillar analogue of the historical Financial-only baseline the inherited guardrails were written against

inheritedHardGuardrails.classificationRule: each guardrail is classified in the report as inherited-hard-gate, inherited-diagnostic-only, or obsolete, with a stated reason; none may be silently discarded

inheritedChaseContract.C1: clear-Financial overrides == 0 AND max overturned Financial gap < 10, on base and all +/-10% shocks
inheritedChaseContract.C3: Financial variance share > 0.80 AND Chase variance share < 0.20
inheritedChaseContract.C4: Spearman >= 0.98 vs CONTROL AND top-5 turnover <= 1
inheritedChaseContract.note: raising Collector lowers Financial, which changes Chase's relative strength even though Chase stays at 0.06

populationSchemes.rule: each product in a set of n receives weight 1/n so every set contributes equal total weight

decompositionRule.directCollectorEffect: difference attributable to C differing between the two products compared
decompositionRule.reallocationEffect: difference attributable to the Financial coefficient falling from 0.94-c_old to 0.94-c_new while Chase stays at 0.06
decompositionRule.hardRule: for any pair whose Collector Appeal values are equal, 100% of the change is reallocation effect and MUST NOT be credited to Collector information

shocks.collectorShockRule: symmetric multiplicative only, clamped to the valid 0-100 Collector Appeal bound; declared here before any result was seen

decisionCriteria.gate1: candidate must pass all applicable hard Financial, Collector, Chase and robustness gates
decisionCriteria.gate2: any increase above 0.10 must produce a real increase in COLLECTOR-SPECIFIC information, not movement caused by lowering Financial
decisionCriteria.gate3: the increase must survive dates, shocks, product-weighted AND set-balanced analysis
decisionCriteria.gate4: higher weight must retain comfortable margin on Financial dominance and on the Stage VI-B Chase contract
decisionCriteria.gate5: if 0.10, 0.11, 0.12 and 0.13 all pass but additional weight adds negligible distinct benefit or only amplifies redundancy, retain the LOWEST SUFFICIENT weight (0.10)

selectionRule: Do not select the highest passing weight. Select the lowest weight that is sufficient, unless a higher weight demonstrates stronger, stable, non-redundant COLLECTOR-SPECIFIC behaviour with substantial safety margin.

hierarchyRule.prohibition: raw marginal variance ordering MUST NOT be used as a hard constraint forcing Collector > Chase; Stage VI-A showed covariance and dispersion make that ordering misleading
evaluateBehaviourally: does Collector have wider conceptual scope than Chase
does Chase remain a tertiary close-call modifier

prohibitions: no redesign of Financial RIP V4, Collector Appeal V5 or Chase
no editing of this preregistration after candidate results are seen; a correction requires a new versioned file preserving this one
